subject.title: Feature Request: WhatsApp sticker send support

question: Which public WhatsApp sticker-send contract should OpenClaw support: shared `action=sticker`, a WhatsApp send option such as `asSticker`, automatic WebP detection, or a combined explicit-plus-detection path?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but silent WebP detection can change ordinary image sends and the discussion raises encoding-policy concerns beyond message-type routing.

options.title: Use explicit sticker intent
options.body: Expose `action=sticker` or an explicit WhatsApp send option and only route media as stickers when that intent is present.

options.title: Use automatic WebP detection
options.body: Treat qualifying WebP media as stickers by heuristic, accepting the risk that ordinary WebP image sends or malformed sticker assets may be misclassified.

options.title: Defer channel feature
options.body: Keep inbound sticker support only until a broader cross-channel sticker contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Use explicit sticker intent
recommendation.body: Expose `action=sticker` or an explicit WhatsApp send option and only route media as stickers when that intent is present.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr has the strongest recent history on the lower-level structured WhatsApp send helper and adjacent live QA coverage.
